## Checklist

- [ ] Uses the shared component classes, without restyling them in a screen or flow stylesheet
- [ ] Persona names and photos match, and the same people are used as on other screens
- [ ] Wording follows the prototype: "learners" in the educator flow, "District administrator" for the district role
- [ ] No "·" or "|" between content (badges, right-aligned values or separate lines instead)
- [ ] No text smaller than 14px
- [ ] Checked at mobile width
